Valentina tells you that the connection between Honami's Sonoro and the real world is stabilizing. Chisa has completed her treatment and shows no serious lingering Overclocking symptoms. However, she recently went back to Honami alone for reasons unknown. Her guide, KU-Shosho, might know more. KU-Shosho explains that Chisa usually rests at the Haven of Sprouts, but has been in low spirits lately. She left in a hurry without even cleaning up her kirigami on the table. This unusual behavior prompts you to search for her in Honami. After some searching, you find Chisa on the pedway. She opens up about what's been troubling her—While she spent only two months in Honami, more than twenty years passed in the outside world. Unsure how to face a world that now feels unfamiliar, she asks you to walk with her for a while, perhaps... to the lake surrounded by cherry blossoms. The vending machine jams and fails to dispense a drink, but Chisa seems to know exactly how to deal with the situation... Chisa hands you a drink and begins to share painful memories from her past. As a Resonator, she faced constant discrimination in her hometown, even at school. Just when she felt she couldn't take any more, she received an acceptance letter from Startorch Academy. There, she was treated with kindness by the teachers and her classmates. At a fountain, you discover a strange cassette, a device unique to Lahai-Roi. Every Startorch Academy student carries a similar frequency storage cassette in their Terminal. Chisa decides to bring it to Namipon, hoping it can help you locate its origin. With the cherry blossoms so close, the two of you decide to take a picture together. Under the cherry blossoms, Chisa returns your old student ID, revealing that you too once attended Startorch Academy in the past. Still, what matters more to her is the you she met in Honami, and she wants to know you better. You tell her stories of your adventures in Rinascita, and she confides her own uncertainties about the future. Your response moves her, and she says she's drawn strength from the journey you've shared. She then gives you a gift: an intricate kirigami of her hometown she made during her recovery in the Black Shores. A piece filled with feeling and memory. Finally, she suggests inviting your Black Shores friends to the cafe to celebrate a real "opening day." The next day, you and Abby arrive near Shashou Cafe. It is Abby's first time visiting this coffeehouse. You have already asked Shorekeeper to notify your friends in the Black Shores, and they should be arriving soon. Chisa and Namipon have already decorated the cafe for the opening party. Right away, Abby finds Namipon suspicious and uneasy, seeing how close you and Namipon are. As the two face off, an unaware Chisa asks you to help place the final decorations. With the help of a Rice Dango, Abby and Namipon bury the hatchet. Feeling a little guilty, Abby offers to help Namipon with the rest of the party prep. Namipon privately tells you it wants to surprise Chisa with a special piece of decor. With your input, it finishes the special piece in secret... When Chisa sees the life-sized cutout of herself placed at the cafe entrance, she falls silent in astonishment. She then turns and asks your opinion of it... Not long after, Shorekeeper arrives. It turns out Chisa already met her while recovering in the Black Shores. Later, Buling arrives and lightens the mood. Although Chisa has heard of her from you, this is their first meeting. Namipon then leads Buling inside. Buling tells you that Honami feels quiet, likely because many of the "people" who once lived there have already faded away. The radio suddenly picks up a signal from outside the Sonoro. On a talk show hosted by the Pioneer Association, special guest Aalto recounts an incident he dealt with in Lilyland, where someone attempted to resell the Troupe of Fools' tour tickets at outrageous prices... From Shorekeeper, you learn that no other guests are expected. Of everyone invited, only Shorekeeper, Encore, and Buling were able to come. Encore turned down the invite, choosing instead to finish the homework assigned by the Tethys System. Her newfound dedication to studying might be because Chisa tutored her in math during her time spent in the Haven of Sprouts... After trying the cafe's coffee, Shorekeeper shares news about Startorch Academy: the region of Lahai-Roi, where the Academy is located, has been sealed off by the Void Storm, making normal travel there impossible. As you and Chisa absorb this information, a familiar companion arrives. It's Camellya, who finished her mission early and rushed over as soon as she heard about Honami and your situation. Camellya imagines how exciting it would have been to explore Honami with you, saying she wishes she had been dragged into the crisis with you. Seeing Chisa's potential, she invites her to take part in the "germination test" she will hold once Chisa has fully recovered. Although the time you spent with your friends was short, every moment was captured forever. Now it feels clear and close enough to see and touch. Namipon explains that you fell asleep after seeing your friends off, though you have no memory of what happened after watching the meteor shower. When you ask about Chisa, you learn that she woke up earlier and went outside for some air. With the opening party a success, Chisa seems more at ease. She shares with you her plans. She wants to return home to find her parents first, and then go back to Startorch Academy to finish her studies. Neither will be easy, but she believes she can overcome the challenge just as she did with you in Neon Tower. Though saddened by the coming farewell, she trusts that you will meet again once everything is settled. As you and Chisa return to the cafe, Rover frequency suddenly started leaking into a singular direction. Unable to retrieve or stop their Frequency from being drained further, Rover severed the frequency from further harm. A rift then appears and beyond it, appears a familiar sight to Chisa: Startorch Academy. Some time later, a team from the Black Shores arrives. Shorekeeper checks your condition and confirms your vitals are stable, and the frequency loss you experienced has stopped. The leading theory is that the sudden spatial rift acts as a conduit to Lahai-Roi, the very region where your frequency was drawn. Investigating that region may be the only way to discover the root cause. Chisa suggests using the rift as a direct route, but the Shorekeeper warns it is too unstable and unsafe for travel for now. Near the rift, Platya finds the radio Chisa had taken outside the cafe earlier. It's now emitting heavy static. Namipon, seeming to recall something, asks you to adjust the receiver. After some tuning, the signal clears. The broadcast is an interview about school uniforms, and Chisa recognizes who the guest speaker is... It turns out to be a Startorch Academy radio program, and the guest is Chisa's mother, who is currently at the Academy. By tracing the signal, Namipon can pinpoint Lahai-Roi's relative coordinates. With support from the Black Shores, securing safe passage through the rift may soon be possible. Since her family is at the Academy, Chisa changes her plan and decides to return there first. You, too, have your own reasons for going. Lahai-Roi is now your next destination. As you prepare to leave, a mysterious voice suddenly cuts through the radio... Strangely, Chisa, standing beside you, doesn't hear it.
